description: The 'scenario_runs_cached' dataset provides detailed information about various scenario executions within a project. Each entry in the dataset represents a unique scenario run, identified by a combination of project, scenario, and run identifiers. This dataset is particularly useful for tracking the execution history of scenarios, analyzing performance, and diagnosing issues based on the outcome and warnings generated during each run. Key features include timestamps for the start and end of each run, allowing for precise duration calculations, and the outcome status, which indicates whether a run was successful, failed, or aborted. Additionally, the dataset captures the user and method of execution, providing insights into who initiated the run and under what context. This information is crucial for auditing and compliance purposes. The dataset can be used by project managers, developers, and analysts to monitor scenario performance, optimize processes, and ensure accountability in scenario execution.
shortDesc: Dataset of scenario runs with identifiers and timestamps.

columns.name: scenario_project_key
columns.comment: Project identifier for the scenario, project key.

columns.name: scenario_id
columns.comment: Unique identifier for each scenario, scenario key.

columns.name: scenario_run_id
columns.comment: Unique identifier for each scenario run, run key.

columns.name: time_start
columns.comment: Timestamp when the scenario run started, start time.

columns.name: time_end
columns.comment: Timestamp when the scenario run ended, end time.

columns.name: outcome
columns.comment: Result of the scenario run, run outcome status.

columns.name: warnings_count

columns.name: scenario_name

columns.name: scenario_run_as_user

columns.name: run_as_user_via
columns.comment: Method or context of user execution, execution context.
